metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.4 · 1984 · A Nightmare on Elm Street
metas.description: Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in rea...

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.5 · 1985 · A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
metas.description: A teenage boy is haunted in his dreams by deceased child murderer Freddy Krueger, who is out to possess him in order to continue his reign of terror in the real world.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.7 · 1987 · A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
metas.description: A psychiatrist, familiar with the knife-wielding dream demon Freddy Krueger, helps teens at a mental hospital battle the killer who is invading their dreams.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.7 · 1988 · A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master
metas.description: Freddy Krueger returns once again to terrorize the dreams of the remaining Dream Warriors, as well as those of a young woman who may be able to defeat him for good.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.1 · 1989 · A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Child
metas.description: The pregnant Alice finds Freddy Krueger striking through the sleeping mind of her unborn child, hoping to be reborn into the real world.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 4.7 · 1991 · Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare
metas.description: Dream-haunting Freddy Krueger returns once again to prowl the nightmares of Springwood's last surviving teenager, and of a woman whose personal connection to Krueger may mean his doom.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.4 · 1994 · New Nightmare
metas.description: A demonic force has chosen Freddy Krueger as its portal to the real world. Can Heather Langenkamp play the part of Nancy one last time and trap the evil trying to enter our world?

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.2 · 2010 · A Nightmare on Elm Street
metas.description: The spectre of a disfigured man haunts the children of the parents who murdered him, stalking and killing them in their dreams.
